line_item_number.description: The line item reference number exactly as printed on the form. Preserve every dot, parenthesis, and prefix. Examples: '1.a.(1)(a)', '5.d.(6)', '10.', 'M.7.k.', 'M.3.'. Memoranda items always start with 'M.' — do not drop the 'M.' prefix.

description.description: The full text description of the line item exactly as printed, including all sub-clause text. Do not truncate. Do not include dot leaders (...) or footnote reference numbers (superscripts). Examples: 'Loans secured by 1-4 family residential properties', 'Change in net unrealized holding gains (losses) on equity securities not held for trading'.

mdrm_code.description: The 4-character alphanumeric MDRM identifier code for this line item, without the prefix. Located immediately after the prefix (e.g. 'BHCK4435' → '4435', 'BHCKB488' → 'B488'). If two MDRM codes appear (e.g. a domestic and foreign split), capture the primary one. If not visible, return null.

mdrm_prefix.description: The prefix immediately before the MDRM code indicating the reporting entity. Most common: 'BHCK' (consolidated BHC). Others: 'BHDM' (domestic offices), 'BHFN' (foreign offices), 'BHTX' (text field), 'BHOD'. If no prefix is explicitly printed, default to 'BHCK'.

data_type.description: Inferred data type of the field. Use: 'dollar' for amounts reported in thousands of dollars; 'percentage' for rates or ratios; 'count' for integers (number of employees, accounts); 'text' for open text response fields; 'yes_no' for binary indicator cells (0=No, 1=Yes); 'date' for date fields.

parent_line_item.description: Reference number of the immediate parent category this item belongs to, preserving exact formatting. Item '1.a.(1)(a)' → parent '1.a.(1)'; item '1.a.(1)' → parent '1.a.'; item '1.a.' → parent '1.'. Top-level items ('1.', '2.', 'M.1.') have null parent. Memoranda sub-items ('M.7.k.') have parent 'M.7.'.

is_total_or_subtotal.description: True only if the row is a computed aggregate — its label contains words like 'Total', 'Subtotal', 'Net', or 'Sum of items'. False for all individual data-entry fields. When uncertain, default to false.

schedule_name.description: The official schedule designation from the page header. Examples: 'Schedule HI', 'Schedule HC-B', 'Schedule HC-R Part I'. Use exactly the wording in the header, including any Part qualifiers.

section.description: The sub-section or part within the schedule, if clearly labelled. Examples: 'Part I', 'Part II', 'Memoranda', 'Column A — Held-to-Maturity'. Return null if the schedule has no explicit section divisions.

reporting_threshold.description: Any asset-size or entity-type threshold printed near this row that determines whether a filer must complete it. Examples: 'Total assets $5 billion or more', 'Advanced approaches holding companies only', 'Not applicable for S&L holding companies'. Return null if all filers must complete this item.

footnotes.description: Footnote text (not just the number) associated with this line item, as a list of strings. Example: ['To be completed by holding companies with $5 billion or more in total assets']. Return null if no footnotes apply.
